name: discharge-summary
title: Discharge Summary
description: Comprehensive inpatient transition-of-care summary: hospital course, primary/secondary diagnoses, reconciled discharge meds, and follow-up.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { AlertTriangle, Building, Calendar, CheckCircle2, Clock, FileCheck2, FileText, Home, Hospital, Pill, Printer, ShieldCheck, Stethoscope, UserCheck, } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { ClinicalStatusBadge, type ClinicalStatus } from "@/components/medicn/clinical-status-badge" export type DischargeCondition = "stable" | "improved" | "guarded" | "critical" export type DischargeDisposition = "home" | "snf" | "rehab" | "hospice" | "ama" | "expired" export interface DischargeMedication { name: string sig: string status: "continued" | "new" | "changed" | "discontinued" } export interface DischargeSummaryData { id?: string patientName: string mrn?: string dateOfBirth?: string admissionDate: string dischargeDate: string attendingPhysician: string primaryDiagnosis: string secondaryDiagnoses?: string[] hospitalCourse: string dischargeCondition: DischargeCondition dischargeDisposition: DischargeDisposition medications?: DischargeMedication[] followUpInstructions?: string followUpAppointments?: { provider: string; specialty: string; timeFrame: string }[] signedAt?: string } export const DISCHARGE_CONDITION_LABELS: Record = { stable: "Stable", improved: "Improved", guarded: "Guarded", critical: "Critical", } export const DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_LABELS: Record = { home: "Home / Self-care", snf: "Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)", rehab: "Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility", hospice: "Hospice Care", ama: "Against Medical Advice (AMA)", expired: "Deceased", } export function getDischargeConditionStatus(cond: DischargeCondition): ClinicalStatus { switch (cond) { case "stable": case "improved": return "normal" case "guarded": return "watch" case "critical": return "critical" } } const medStatusClasses: Record = { new: { label: "New", status: "info" }, continued: { label: "Continued", status: "normal" }, changed: { label: "Changed", status: "watch" }, discontinued: { label: "Discontinued", status: "abnormal" }, } export interface DischargeSummaryProps extends Omit, "title"> { summary: DischargeSummaryData onSign?: (summary: DischargeSummaryData) => void onPrint?: () => void readOnly?: boolean title?: React.ReactNode } export function DischargeSummary({ summary, onSign, onPrint, readOnly = false, title = "Hospital Discharge Summary", className, ...props }: DischargeSummaryProps) { const conditionStatus = getDischargeConditionStatus(summary.dischargeCondition) return (
{/* Document Header */}

{title}

Inpatient Transition of Care Record

{DISCHARGE_CONDITION_LABELS[summary.dischargeCondition]} {DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_LABELS[summary.dischargeDisposition]}
{/* Patient & Stay Timeline */}
Patient

{summary.patientName}

{summary.mrn &&

MRN: {summary.mrn}

}
Admission & Discharge

Admitted: {summary.admissionDate}

Discharged: {summary.dischargeDate}

Attending Physician

{summary.attendingPhysician}

Internal Medicine Service

Disposition

{DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_LABELS[summary.dischargeDisposition]}

Condition: {DISCHARGE_CONDITION_LABELS[summary.dischargeCondition]}

{/* Diagnoses */}
Discharge Diagnoses
Primary {summary.primaryDiagnosis}
{summary.secondaryDiagnoses && summary.secondaryDiagnoses.length > 0 && (
Secondary / Comorbid Diagnoses:
    {summary.secondaryDiagnoses.map((diag, idx) => (
  • {diag}
    • ))}
)}
{/* Hospital Course */}
Hospital Course Narrative
{summary.hospitalCourse}
{/* Discharge Medications */} {summary.medications && summary.medications.length > 0 && (
Reconciled Discharge Medications
{summary.medications.map((med, idx) => { const config = medStatusClasses[med.status] return (

{med.name}

{med.sig}

{config.label}
) })}
)} {/* Follow-up Care & Appointments */}
Follow-up Care & Appointments
{summary.followUpAppointments && summary.followUpAppointments.length > 0 && (
{summary.followUpAppointments.map((app, idx) => (
{app.provider}

{app.specialty}

Timeline: {app.timeFrame}

))}
)} {summary.followUpInstructions && (
Return Precautions & Patient Instructions

{summary.followUpInstructions}

)}
{/* Footer & Actions */}
{summary.signedAt ? ( Finalized on {summary.signedAt} ) : ( Physician sign-off required for transition of care. )}
{onPrint && ( )} {!readOnly && onSign && ( )}
) }
